record.empirical_limit: Invented deterministic schedule; no human service-time distribution, queue or field effect measured.
record.mechanism: Three legitimately required2minute tasks share one exclusive actor and a5minute deadline. Every single task and every pair fits; all three require6minutes before any1minute resumption penalty.
record.name: Shared response capacity can fail only in the joint duty set
record.novelty: Higher-order instance, not new property. ECSE-21already covers aggregate resource demand and ESS-011already covers temporal composition; P007identifies a specific work source.
record.pairwise_result: All three pair subsets take4minutes and pass the model deadline. No pairwise feasibility certificate entails joint feasibility.
record.r10_novelty: Useful explicit component composition; no distinct new property identity or new necessity of all three lineages is established.
record.r10_reassessment: O02 shows the effect of one additional actual duty on an already complete recovery schedule and the effect of a genuinely separate resource. O06 compares one versus two responses and actual parallel capacity. These support careful resource mapping but do not replace X04’s exact all-pairs-pass/triple-fail witness.
record.r10_removal_comparison: Remove a truly unnecessary gate or acquisition and the corresponding duty disappears; remove it only from the accounting while retaining its legitimate purpose and the claim becomes unsupported. A separate actually capable actor changes capacity. Original parent/lineage and arity results remain.
record.r11_reassessment: The original pair-pass/triple-fail resource counterexample remains exact. CW-A02 adds a distinct gate/resource constraint example, not a new proof of triple necessity: genuinely parallel actors can change the answer, while a nominal actor or badge does not.
record.r12_reassessment: Original X04 pair-pass/triple-fail remains exact. SC-A02 adds a distinct same-route resource/deadline discriminator, not another proof of three-parent necessity. A shared resource stays shared; a genuinely available separate resource can change the path.
record.r4_reassessment: V07 specializes the same exclusive-resource mechanism: three actual duties of three units each fit pairwise within eight, while nine units do not. Already adequate reference evidence removes the check; real parallel capacity changes the resource premise. This is not a new property.
record.r5_reassessment: A10 adds real inspection/feedback and resumption demand but is not an all-pairs-pass example. A11 demonstrates a different parallel gate path. The original X04 and V07 all-pairs countermodels remain exact; do not transfer their stronger arity claim to every new task set. The loss/use boundary may identify an additional real competing obligation, but A16 is a scope/interpretation discriminator, not an all-pairs workload proof. A15 supplies separate task feasibility only.
record.r6_reassessment: Actual inspection and correction can supply further resource demands, but B03 does not establish an all-pairs-pass/triple-fail result. The exact X04 and V07 witnesses remain the basis for that stronger arity claim.
record.r6_removal_comparison: A genuinely unnecessary duty or adequate current evidence can remove work; removing a name cannot. Actual independent resources change the schedule.
record.r7_reassessment: The original X04 three-duty example still has every pair feasible and the joint triple infeasible. L01 adds a continuing lifecycle comparison in which two complete responses already fail; it must not be promoted to a new triple-only effect. Actual response multiplicity is a native ECSE-19 constraint, not new irreducibility.
record.r8_reassessment: Preserve the original three-duty pair-pass/triple-fail example. The new state/context cases are not another resource hyperedge; one pair already expresses the bounded lot-to-consumer input. No arity is inflated.

removal_tests.ECSE-21: Removing the human resource accounting hides exclusivity; declaring it removed does not create capacity. Physically adding a competent independent resource changes the model.
removal_tests.ESS-011: A legitimately wider hazard deadline can make the schedule feasible; redefining a deadline without authority does not.
removal_tests.P007: If the measurement/uncertainty task is genuinely unnecessary or replaced by adequate existing evidence, that2minute duty can be removed. Merely skipping required measurement invalidates the claim.

record.simpler_alternatives: One integrated adequate discriminator, offline prior preparation, safe deadline extension or real competent parallel capacity. No blanket extra staffing/check mandate.
record.triple_result: The three-way demand violates capacity/deadline; delay/resumption can worsen it. This is a concrete resource hyperedge.

record.empirical_limit: No new sequential theorem, real-time controller or actual clinical threshold tested.
record.mechanism: Time-uniform evidence validity, human interpretation/permission and adaptive physical control have different targets and deadlines. The actual critical path includes evidence availability, parallelizable dependencies, actuation and stabilization.
record.name: Valid evidence may describe the wrong state or arrive after useful control
record.novelty: Not a new irreducible law. Existing temporal/capacity, model-scope and envelope criteria already express the obligations; the synthesis supplies their explicit guarded mapping.
record.pairwise_result: A valid sequence plus readable display can still miss the hazard deadline; a fast capable response plus a permitted envelope can use a statistically unsupported or wrong-target assertion; a statistically valid estimate plus a physical controller does not establish the human transition.
record.r10_novelty: Useful explicit component composition; no distinct new property identity or new necessity of all three lineages is established.
record.r10_reassessment: O01/O04 sharpen different evidence targets: fixed lot acceptance, implemented action, earlier restoration and current context/effect can differ. O02 supplies a full achieved-state endpoint and actual precedence, not merely a first movement. The explicit control mechanism consumes these partial inputs without obtaining full proof from any one.
record.r10_removal_comparison: Adequate current direct evidence can replace new acquisition; a genuinely autonomous adequate path can remove the human transition; a pure theorem remains mathematical. Gate/role evidence is required only where that actual realization credits it.
record.r11_reassessment: A bounded task model exposes actual prerequisite order and the independently fixed useful window. CW-A02 distinguishes13,17 and18 completion while CW-A03 keeps current effect and permitted action-context apart. Neither extra CWA phases nor model correctness supplies evidence validity, authority or real actuation.
record.r12_reassessment: The declared safety question requires final useful feedback, valid/current correspondence and actual permission/context. SC-A01/A02 expose independently failing premises while retaining direct sufficient observations. No added theorem or universal three-lineage law follows.
record.r4_reassessment: V05 changes the physical completion-time comparison while target and task order stay fixed. Correct reference cannot repair a wrong target, missing observation or absent response path.
record.r5_reassessment: A01 and A11 retain the actual completed-recovery target and dependency path. A valid local or statistical result can be true yet inapplicable to the current environment, as A04 shows. The model and external realization remain separate. A15 ties the actual recovery requirement to feasible safety options with taxonomy fixed; the source supplies a criterion or evidence input, not normative sufficiency or measured recovery. A16 can change which current-use premise the timing claim serves.
record.r6_reassessment: The P026 example adds an operating-risk constraint on acquisition work; the P027 example adds real diagnosis, implementation and effect requirements. Both change a named complete-path input without proving the complete receiver. Fixed-plan sampling is distinct from the inherited sequential-evidence example.
record.r6_removal_comparison: Removing inspection legitimately requires adequate same-claim evidence or no actual duty. Removing effect verification while still claiming restored process changes or invalidates the endpoint. An adequate direct or automatic path remains possible.
record.r7_reassessment: A risk-valid bounded lot observation can still be the wrong target for required process state or arrive after useful intervention. A current primary-effect observation can settle one state/purpose premise while another protection remains. Keeping these distinctions does not require every component to prove the complete receiving system.
record.r8_reassessment: M01/M02 strengthen the explicit target distinction: risk-valid lot evidence and an implemented command can coexist with incompatible current effects, and current effect alone can leave action context unresolved. Native ESS008 and ECSE10 already express those needs; admitting a partial input does not prove the full realization.

removal_tests.ECSE-14: A validated automatic/continuously engaged path can remove takeover; mere absence of a human does not validate the substitute.
removal_tests.ESS-045: A pure mathematical coverage theorem remains valid without an actual control system. The operational envelope duty arises only when applying it to control.
removal_tests.P038: A complete direct current-state discriminator can replace sequential estimation for a bounded task. Arbitrary fixed-time peeking cannot.

record.simpler_alternatives: Fixed allocation, a passive barrier, direct state guard or offline evidence; choose by the represented failure class.
record.triple_result: The full guarded realization needs target correspondence and actual timely capacity; each partial contribution remains useful even when the whole realization is unresolved.

record.empirical_limit: X07is exact arithmetic on invented response tables, not a measured training or assurance intervention.
record.mechanism: Changing the evaluator or system can preserve nominal scores while altering measurement mapping, expected behavior and the applicability of hazard evidence. The same change is one common cause across the three interfaces.
record.name: A common change can jointly stale evidence, human expectations and control assumptions
record.novelty: Existing currentness and change predicates subsume this common-cause dependency. No new property identity is admitted.
record.pairwise_result: An old/new bridge with no human-work check can miss expectation mismatch; trained operators with unchanged labels can rely on invalid evidence; affected hazard reassessment without attribution can accept the wrong candidate/evaluator interpretation.
record.r10_novelty: Useful explicit component composition; no distinct new property identity or new necessity of all three lineages is established.
record.r10_reassessment: O04 changes effect age, action context or transmitted gate/role facts while preserving a coarse completed label. O03 changes role availability/activation while a title stays fixed. These exemplify current applicability at actual dependencies, not a universal common-cause inference from an unchanged label.
record.r10_removal_comparison: An unaffected claim can retain its evidence. Removing the actual human interpretation or role transition removes its specific cognitive premise; changing a label alone does not create or remove a dependency. The original measurement-bridge and change comparisons remain.
record.r11_reassessment: A changed gate, resource or purpose can stale the bounded model. Re-evaluate affected premises and retain unaffected exact evidence. Current analysis selection is not a second independent observation, and no new change-effect estimate is supplied.
record.r12_reassessment: A changed mode, feedback validity/age, resource, assignment or cooling requirement can stale only the model-dependent claim. This is a native currentness/premise dependency, not a fresh measured change-effect or proof that unchanged evidence must be reacquired.
record.r4_reassessment: Changed reference, range, result mapping or clock relation can stale an actual evidence premise, cognitive expectation and safety claim together. Propagation follows actual dependencies; unrelated claims do not inherit it.
record.r5_reassessment: A08 shows one factual change consumed at current-use, cheap-check and explicit barrier boundaries. This is one shared fact and three distinct implications, not three independent studies or a new three-lineage hyperedge. Actual affected-dependency propagation remains the existing criterion. The native safety evaluation and cognitive current-use interfaces identify additional actual dependencies through which a change may propagate. Their 260 examined directions do not themselves establish a higher-order interaction or independent evidence multiplication.
record.r6_reassessment: Changed inspection error or source identity can stale reused lot evidence; changed process mechanism can stale corrective-effect claims. The same change can have several consumers without multiplying independent evidence.
record.r6_removal_comparison: If no material lot/process/evaluator premise changes, reuse can remain justified. No consequential human interpretation removes that cognitive component; a change outside safety need not acquire a safety case.
record.r7_reassessment: At an actual changed allocation or handoff, nominal completion counts can conceal a changed selected-unit set or a still-pending effect duty. Preserve the particular content and current purpose; generic communication/format efficacy is not established by the construction.
record.r8_reassessment: M01 permits the same earlier restored observation with different current effects. Currentness must follow the actual state transition and context. This adds no new universal change property and does not demand rechecking unrelated unchanged claims.

removal_tests.ECSE-31: No consequential human interpretation in the changed path removes that cognitive premise.
removal_tests.ESS-029: A change outside any relevant safety claim can remove safety re-assurance duty; it does not remove measurement comparability or normal work requirements.
removal_tests.P052: A direct decisive independent discriminator may remove the need for a2×2bridge; attribution cannot be inferred from a confounded diagonal.

record.simpler_alternatives: Fixed evaluator with controlled candidate change; verified equivalent interface; one decisive common evidence route.
record.triple_result: A bounded change account links the relevant measurement comparison, work expectation and affected safety claim. Unchanged independent claims may still be reused.

record.empirical_limit: X06is physical-channel algebra. It does not give probabilities for human or agent reviewers.
record.mechanism: Separate inquiries can share a reference, specification or incentive; correlated results may add conditional information but not independent replication. Added coordination can consume capacity before intervention.
record.name: Nominally diverse assurance can share one error while consuming the response window
record.novelty: Not new: informational independence, experimental-unit replication and assurance diversity are already separately native. Their difference must be preserved rather than merged.
record.pairwise_result: Cognitive independence plus statistical units does not meet a domain-specific assurance duty automatically; an assurance organization plus repeated measurements does not remove common bias; separated organizations plus distinct briefing does not create independent sampling units.
record.r10_novelty: Useful explicit component composition; no distinct new property identity or new necessity of all three lineages is established.
record.r10_reassessment: Root r9’s P026 origin/independent-reuse repair remains exact. O05 separately varies physical failure coverage, information-rival discrimination and repeated uses of one acquisition. A newly constructed process-effect origin can be linked to the same consumer names, while frozen H04’s P027 event remains unlinked. Thus consumer names alone do not establish or refute correspondence.
record.r11_reassessment: Several native properties can describe one actual bounded model without becoming several independent acquisitions. CWA/ECSE02 overlap is recognized, not counted as independent evidence or a novel three-lineage mechanism. A shared resource or supply remains shared despite distinct method names.
record.r12_reassessment: ECSE02 and ECSE45 overlapping in one bounded model do not supply independent acquisitions. SC-A03 is one thermal process with an explicitly shared needed function; it supplies no redundancy-channel probability or reviewer independence law. Existing X06 limits remain.
record.r4_reassessment: V06 demonstrates a possible common-reference covariance. It estimates neither real channel dependence nor reviewer dependence. Characterized covariance, a genuinely independent reference or one sufficient result remain alternatives.
record.r5_reassessment: A05 separates source validity/common context from actor independence and unique observations; A09 separates joint barrier dependence from equal marginal rates or layer count. No single independence label or duplicated report can substitute for the particular dependency question. Cognitive loss-feedback understanding and safety assurance currentness are distinct from information independence. A15/A16 do not create independent observations, even when the same actual task supports multiple recipients.
record.r6_reassessment: Random sampling, actual resource parallelism, information independence and institutional independence remain different. Two real stations can reduce elapsed work without becoming two independent lot samples; copying one defect record adds no sample.
record.r6_removal_comparison: One adequate current discriminator may replace multiple evidence routes; correlated valid information is not automatically worthless. Physical channel algebra and finite sampling probabilities are not reviewer-error estimates.
record.r7_reassessment: Repeated inspection of the same units is not nine independent unique units; two labels for the same effect do not provide separate protection. Existing independence distinctions remain native and typed. Real independent capacity or an adequate distinct observation changes the stipulated model.
record.r8_reassessment: One lot observation used by ESS010, ESS008 and ECSE10 is still one evidence source. Multiple native consumers do not make it independent replication, independent protection or distinct field confirmation.
record.r9_novelty: No new property identity: both informational dependence and native result traceability/interpretation already have owners. This is a corrected pair of guarded inputs supporting an existing higher-order distinction, not a new irreducibility proof.
record.r9_reassessment: The existing correct one-lot-observation/three-consumer conclusion has an explicit native owner. P026 traceability is the input to ESS013 evidence-source dependence; ESS013 separately constrains the traceability/interpretation needed for that reuse. N01 changes the evidence-generating structure while holding the number of consumers fixed. N03 distinguishes different acquisitions from independent error causes. Source, informational, physical, human/institutional and resource independence remain typed separately.

removal_tests.ECSE-25: One decisive check can remove exploratory diversity if no live alternate hypothesis needs it.
removal_tests.ESS-025: A low-consequence bounded task with no applicable separation duty may not need an assurance portfolio.
removal_tests.P032: A formal theorem or one complete physical discriminator can settle a claim without empirical replication; residual population claims remain separate.

record.simpler_alternatives: One adequate distinct source, targeted challenge, adequate physical invariant or an integrated review with independently empowered reporting.
record.triple_result: Name what is independent—people, information, methods, units, failures or authority—and the specific residual error it addresses; evaluate total work. No universal commutative independence property follows.

record.empirical_limit: No organization-specific utilities, latent demand probabilities or maintenance costs were estimated.
record.mechanism: Each artifact can have a plausible prospective consumer yet all consume one scarce attention/time budget; latent safety value may justify a quiet control, while duplication and indefinite speculative use may not.
record.name: Locally cheap evidence additions can destroy the joint useful window
record.novelty: The retained native prospective-value, live/latent consumer and proportionate-portfolio criteria already express the result. Zero new identity.
record.pairwise_result: Positive information value without practical consumption can be unusable; a live human consumer without hazard relevance can be wasteful; a safety use without acquisition and maintenance costs can exceed feasible resources.
record.r10_novelty: Useful explicit component composition; no distinct new property identity or new necessity of all three lineages is established.
record.r10_reassessment: O06 makes each consumer explicit: current state, structure/dependency, learning and continuing protection can need different coverage. O02 counts actual gate, recovery and competing duty resources. A locally inexpensive addition can be infeasible jointly, and a larger history artifact can remain justified by a real separate purpose.
record.r10_removal_comparison: Remove a real consumer or replace it with an equally adequate cheaper path and the associated work can disappear. Preserve categorical/credible latent duties and genuine remaining learning. The mechanism is already covered by native prospective value, consumer and total-burden criteria.
record.r11_reassessment: CW-A04 executes the whole finite option set for independent purposes. State-only selects the existing fact; structure selects the small model; a continuing learning requirement retains history; all three purposes jointly cost10 in the stipulated options. Extra phases add no coverage here. A required latent/learning duty cannot be removed by narrowing the objective after the fact.
record.r12_reassessment: Compare the complete useful response and legitimate alternative against actual duties. A model or extra acquisition can be omitted for an already settled state-only claim; a necessary cooling or protection function cannot be deleted merely to make work cheaper. SC-A03 retains the passive-heat simple-stop countercontrol.
record.r4_reassessment: V09 fixes the consumer while changing physical-evidence validity. V07 shows that actually needed additional reference work can consume a shared window. Neither construction orders more checking after sufficient evidence settles the claim.
record.r5_reassessment: A04 preserves the already adequate direct check while allowing an actual stale premise to reopen. A10 makes real feedback/response work visible. Currentness is not a reason for endless acquisition, and absent alarms do not establish absent latent value. A direct current loss-scope observation and a sufficient actual recovery check preserve the cheap path. Native consumer and retention duties remain separate; simplifying labels does not remove a material current-use or control-effectiveness premise.
record.r6_reassessment: Inspection or corrective artifacts can have legitimate future-process value and still consume a scarce current recovery window. A bounded lot claim and a process-restoration claim have different consumers.
record.r6_removal_comparison: When adequate current evidence settles the same claim, repeated acquisition may be omitted. When future process quality is not claimed and there is no relevant leverage, P027 does not mandate a new improvement project.
record.r7_reassessment: Real effect verification and repeated valid work belong in the joint lifecycle window when their consumer is present. Removing a required effect stage is not a cheap adequate alternative; accurate direct communication, valid same-claim current evidence or a faster valid exhaustive route can remove genuine redundancy.
record.r8_reassessment: M03 compares current evidence already present, a direct current check and a larger package stipulated to contain the same discriminator. Extra work is unnecessary for that narrow settled purpose; independent investigation, protection or binding duties remain separate.

removal_tests.ECSE-35: Fully automated consumption can remove human attention cost but introduces its own valid consumer and maintenance questions.
removal_tests.ESS-048: An artifact with no current, credible latent or required safety role may be retired; nonactivation alone does not prove this.
removal_tests.P041: Already available decisive evidence can end the acquisition comparison for that same claim, but not different future or structural claims.

record.simpler_alternatives: Consolidate overlapping artifacts, reuse valid evidence, select a cheaper adequate route, or retain no new artifact.
record.triple_result: The portfolio must preserve legitimate latent decisions and duties while comparing joint acquisition/consumption/maintenance and delay. An unchanged realized action is not a valid zero-value test.

record.empirical_limit: Invented conditional model. No field mixture, human delay, valid stop permission, staffing effectiveness or real operating safety is established.
record.mechanism: The event regime changes complete-recovery demand while the adjustment policy consumes the same actor through action and resumption. Both must be composed with the required state/deadline and other duties.
record.name: A regime shift and reactive adjustment can jointly defeat a complete recovery window
record.novelty: Useful guarded configuration; existing aggregate-capacity, complete recovery, temporal-control and prediction/adjustment predicates already express its necessary criterion. No new property identity.
record.pairwise_result: Recovery alone (4 or 12), adjustment alone (6), and another duty (1) each fit deadline 13. Recovery plus the other duty is 5/13 and also fits. Separately warranted prediction and adjustment criteria do not supply a joint schedule.
record.r10_novelty: Useful explicit component composition; no distinct new property identity or new necessity of all three lineages is established.
record.r10_reassessment: O02 exposes real gate ordering, availability and shared-resource changes in complete recovery; O03 supplies separate task-role conditions. These strengthen the explicit mechanism input account while leaving Z04’s regime/adjustment numbers and limited arity unchanged.
record.r10_removal_comparison: The exact known schedule can replace forecasting; genuine gate omission or actual parallel competence can change the schedule. Deleting verification, assuming authority, using first movement or inventing another resource cannot. No new triple-necessity theorem or human distribution follows.
record.r11_reassessment: Regime dependence and reactive workload remain the original causal variables. Bounded model selection adds no acceleration law, learned human reliability or universal recovery guarantee. Gate/resource criteria enter only if the same actual route is used; simpler adequate endpoints and actual parallel resources remain eligible.
record.r12_reassessment: Preserve original11/19 joint workloads,5/13 fixed-policy alternative and.9/.1 mixture result. SC-A02 adds a separate14-unit deterministic-window comparison; none of its completion values replaces the original regime model. Actual new timing/feedback premises apply only when this same modeled route is consumed.
record.r4_reassessment: The exact Z04 regime/adjustment/resource mechanism and removal tests remain. Z04 does not show every pair fitting. V07 is a separate all-pairs construction with different stipulated durations and is attached to H01; no stronger H06 inference is licensed.
record.r5_reassessment: The exact Z04 values, guard and removals are unchanged. R5 current-use and feedback/gate interfaces can affect applications only after their actual duties are specified. A10/A11 are different constructed cases, so H06 remains the stated separate-feasibility/specified-combination result rather than an all-pairs theorem. An actual changed loss/user boundary can add a real duty or alter a recovery objective in an application, but the original Z04 premises and all removal results remain unchanged. A15/A16 supply no all-pairs-pass proof.
record.r6_reassessment: Keep the original regime/adjustment and specified-combination result unchanged. New inspection/corrective inputs alter an application only when they are real duties on its actual path. B01–B04 do not provide a stronger arity proof for Z04.
record.r6_removal_comparison: A legitimate direct schedule, removal of an unnecessary adjustment, real parallel resources or a permitted safe endpoint can change applicability. Ignoring an actual risk or effect-verification dependency is not a legitimate parent removal.
record.r7_reassessment: Retain the original regime/adjustment calculation and its explicit pairwise limitations: the recovery/adjustment pair can already fail. New lifecycle or handoff consumers arise only with actual mapping and do not produce an all-pairs-pass claim.
record.r8_reassessment: C09 flow is restored as complete strings without changing the regime/adjustment calculation. Current state evidence belongs in the actual complete path when needed; valid existing evidence or a legitimate endpoint can remove that particular work. The original pairwise limitations and absence of a new property remain.

removal_tests.result: An old aggregate conceals changed failure probability; an exact known regime/schedule can validly remove the need for forecasting.
Six units of action/resumption work disappear in the noise-only alternative; this is invalid if a separately justified urgent duty still requires them.
Using first movement replaces the relevant achieved-state target and falsely credits readiness.
Counting only adjustment actions omits three units of actual shared work.
A genuinely separate adequate resource changes the scheduling constraint; merely assuming parallelism is invalid.
One can calculate workload, but the timely-control decision has no specified boundary.

simpler_alternatives: An exact complete schedule or conservative worst-case bound.
No unnecessary adjustment under routine noise; legitimate experiment/urgent correction kept separate.
An actually available adequate parallel resource, redesigned task or bounded safe stop.
record.triple_result: The joint reactive workload is 11/19. A mixture shift from 90% familiar to 90% difficult changes modeled timely completion from .9 to .1. The fixed noise-only policy remains 5/13 and timely in both regimes.

encoding: Repeated exact values use $scientific_ref, resolved through shared-records.json definitions. References preserve every value; they do not create scientific evidence.
